## Background & Philosophy

Miqdad started his programming journey in early 2024, inspired by Mustafa Suleyman's book "The Coming Wave". Guided by a strong curiosity for how artificial intelligence works under the hood, he advanced into deep exploration of machine learning algorithms, model training architectures, and agentic workflows. 

His engineering philosophy centers on continuous learning, consistency, and building practical solutions that solve real software challenges through clean code and deterministic systems.

## Core Technical Skills

- **Machine Learning & Deep Learning:** Model training, convolutional neural networks, transfer learning, computer vision, natural language processing, data pipeline engineering (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn).
- **Agentic AI & Skills Development:** Custom agent skill authoring, tool integrations, deterministic rule engines, context pruning, CLI coding agent workflows.
- **Context Engineering:** AST symbol pruning, dynamic memory injection, token overhead optimization for LLM developer environments.
- **Full-Stack Web Development:** Modern responsive web applications, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript, interactive canvas rendering, clean architecture.
- **Workflow Automation:** Orchestrating enterprise automation using n8n, webhook pipelines, Discord integrations, and Google Workspace endpoints.

## Featured Projects

- [AntiSlop](https://miqdadbadjuber.id/projects/anti-ai-slop.html): An open-source deterministic rule and skill package designed to prevent AI coding agents from generating generic, over-styled UI slop.
- [ContextForge](https://miqdadbadjuber.id/projects/contextforge.html): High-precision context engine for LLM coding agents, reducing token payload overhead through intelligent symbol indexing.
- [DiagramPilot](https://miqdadbadjuber.id/projects/diagrampilot.html): Interactive AI diagram generation engine converting natural language requirements into architectural diagrams.
- [OpenFolio](https://miqdadbadjuber.id/projects/openfolio.html): Minimalist, zero-slop developer portfolio framework built for high performance.
- [Machine Learning Experiments](https://miqdadbadjuber.id/projects/machine-learning.html): Production-grade ML pipelines including Natural Scene Classification (92.4% accuracy), Sentiment Analysis, and Fraud Transaction Clustering.
- [Automation Workflow Engine](https://miqdadbadjuber.id/projects/automation-workflow.html): Self-hosted automation orchestrator connecting multi-platform webhooks and Google Workspace APIs.

## Technical Writing & Articles

- [AntiSlop: Stopping Coding Agents from Generating Generic UI](https://miqdadbadjuber.id/blog/anti-ai-slop.html): Why LLMs possess native bias toward generic styles and how deterministic rule systems eliminate visual hallucinations.
- [Context Engineering vs Fine-Tuning](https://miqdadbadjuber.id/blog/context-engineering-vs-finetuning.html): How surgical context injection and AST symbol pruning outperform static weight retraining in production codebase refactors.
- [Optimizing Canvas 3D ASCII Sphere Renders to a Rock-Solid 60 FPS](https://miqdadbadjuber.id/blog/optimizing-canvas-ascii-60fps.html): Eliminating garbage collection freezes in JavaScript point-cloud math through bitwise integer luminescence precomputation.
- [Building Resilient AI Bots with n8n and Google Workspace](https://miqdadbadjuber.id/blog/ai-agents-n8n-workspace.html): Architecture guide connecting Discord webhooks, self-hosted n8n orchestrators, and Google Apps Script endpoints.
